tag_line: A GPS-style drag-strip performance meter, right in your HUD.
title: Draggy
message:
DRAGGY is a lightweight BeamNG UI app that turns your dashboard into a GPS performance box. It auto-arms when you stage, fires on launch after a true 1-foot rollout, and clocks every benchmark that matters — then remembers your best quarter-mile of the session.

No setup, no calibration. Drop it in, drag it onto the HUD, and send it.

Features
Feature    Detail
    Auto-launch detection    Arms when stopped on throttle, fires the clock automatically
    True 1-ft rollout    Timing starts after the first foot — exactly like a real Draggy
⏱️    0–60 & 60–130 mph    Acceleration benchmarks to 2-decimal precision
️    ⅛ & ¼ mile + trap    Distance splits with trap speed at the line
    Best-run memory    Tracks your quickest quarter of the session
️    True airspeed    Uses real velocity, not wheelspeed (immune to wheelspin/lockup)
⏳    Sim-time clock    Times track simulation time, so slow-mo, fast-mo & pause never skew results
    Live status    READY → STAGED → RUN → DONE with a pulsing launch indicator
